original.description: Inside the scratched metal C a needle and a bobbin prepare to punch a pair of threads into a lockstitch. Initials are carved all around its pedestal.

source_shape: Upper metal C/machine head with left guide/lever, long arm to right needle and lower bed; broad horizontal pedestal/table top, two open paired-leg frames and low central crosspiece/outer feet.

palette.primary: w from TileColor on pedestal and needle; glyph ColorString R is not tiled primary
palette.detail: C on machine C/head/guide and bed
palette.rule: Neutral metal plus independent machine-head role. No red body from fallback glyph or donor tint; source w/C tiled palette authoritative.

native_state: One fixed Items/sw_sewing_machine.bmp. Exact child/MountedFurniture/Furniture declare no power consumer, sewing gameplay part, body frame loop or alternate body tile. Description needle/bobbin action does not authorize sewing motion, power logic or apparel crafting.
native_behavior: Metal, non-solid weight80/non-takeable mounted physics, AV4/HP200, Examiner complexity2, native cover/visibility/tier/crafts tags retained. No native sewing/power/crafting implementation added.
